market_outlook.short_term: Highly volatile and risk-off. $100+ oil drives inflation fears, pressuring Treasuries and equities. US-Iran conflict is the dominant variable. Nvidia earnings (Sept 10) and Apple event create binary catalysts. Expect 3-5% equity volatility. Rate-hike bets rising. Crypto remains suppressed. Trade war with Canada adds noise.
market_outlook.long_term: If US-Iran conflict resolves within 6-8 weeks, oil normalizes and equities recover. Structural themes intact: AI capex cycle, energy transition, defense spending. Social Security and fiscal sustainability remain overhangs. China oil demand decline and India capacity constraints reshape global energy flows. Trade fragmentation (US-Canada, US-China, China-Japan) raises structural costs.
